ms.promise:
All the below outputs will be performed through a proposal in Gimbalabs' Open Governance Space:
・Set up responsibilities for current community activities such as open spaces.
・Create a list of all infrastructure needed for coordination, communication, and governance
・Establish project management tools and practices
・Organizing the current Notion space for all activities and all ongoing cost items (e.g. subscriptions) 

Metrics Capturing:
・All metrics will be captured through our Notion page where proposals are consented on. These proposals give exact numbers on the following:
・Number of learning resources created/updates
・Number of open-source initiatives funded
・Number of techical and non-technical spaces hosted
・Number of learners/developers involved in the community (active participants in projects)
・In addition the attendance from our spaces will be captured through the recorded meeting on zoom and the number of video views will be captured through YouTube analytics. 

Note: These metrics will be shared in the close-out report in the final milestone.
